full_judgment: 2. That the case of the plaintiff, in short, is that the suit land originally belonged to Sibram Agorwala who died leaving son Gobinda Lal Agorwala. Gobinda Agorwala left this country just after partition of India and he died there. Gobinda Lal Agorwala was non-Bengali as such the suit land became the vested property. S.A. record was prepared in the name of Gobinda Lal Agorwala in S.A. Khatian No.405 and the plaintiff possessed the suit land through lease. The defendant took settlement as khas land and that settlement was cancelled on 30.10.85. During R.S. operation, suit land was recorded in the name of defendant Nos. 1 to 3 and on 7.5.97 the defendant threatened to dispossess. Hence the plaintiffs filed the suit.
